entities.name: Marcus Böhme
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcus Böhme is a German professional volleyball player, a member of the Germany national team. The bronze medallist at the 2014 World Championship, and the 2009 European League winner. At the professional club level, he plays for VfB Friedrichshafen.
